rows: Every Formula 1 World Championship season since 1950

rows.vgi.doc_llm: One row per Formula 1 World Championship season from 1950 to the present, with its Wikipedia link. Use it to enumerate valid season arguments.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Every championship season in the Jolpica-F1 archive.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Seasons held so far.", "sql": "SELECT count(*) AS seasons, max(season) AS latest FROM f1.main.seasons"}]
rows.vgi.title: F1 Championship Seasons

rows: CREATE TABLE seasons(season INTEGER, wikipedia_url VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(season));
Classification of the most recent Grand Prix, one row per driver

rows.vgi.doc_llm: The full classification of the most recently completed Grand Prix, one row per driver: position, points, grid, laps, status, time, and fastest lap. Use race_results() for any other race and sprint_results() for sprints.
rows.vgi.doc_md: The most recent Grand Prix classification as an ordinary read-only table.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Podium of the latest Grand Prix.", "sql": "SELECT race_name, position, driver_name, constructor_name, race_time FROM f1.main.last_race_results WHERE position <= 3 ORDER BY position"}, {"description": "Biggest gainers from grid to finish in the latest race.", "sql": "SELECT driver_name, grid, position, grid - position AS places_gained FROM f1.main.last_race_results WHERE classified AND grid > 0 ORDER BY places_gained DESC LIMIT 5"}]
rows.vgi.title: Last Grand Prix Result

rows: CREATE TABLE last_race_results(season INTEGER, round INTEGER, race_name VARCHAR, race_date DATE, circuit_id VARCHAR, circuit_name VARCHAR, country VARCHAR, "position" INTEGER, position_text VARCHAR, classified BOOLEAN, points DECIMAL(7,2), car_number INTEGER, driver_id VARCHAR, driver_code VARCHAR, driver_name VARCHAR, driver_nationality VARCHAR, constructor_id VARCHAR, constructor_name VARCHAR, grid INTEGER, laps INTEGER, status VARCHAR, race_time_millis BIGINT, race_time VARCHAR, fastest_lap_rank INTEGER, fastest_lap_number INTEGER, fastest_lap_time VARCHAR, fastest_lap_seconds DECIMAL(10,3), fastest_lap_avg_speed_kph DOUBLE, PRIMARY KEY(driver_id));
Current-season race calendar, one row per round

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Every round of the current season with race date, circuit, country, and UTC session start times. Use it for the next race (race_date >= current_date) or sprint weekends. Use schedule() for other seasons.
rows.vgi.doc_md: The current season calendar. Session starts are UTC timestamps.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Remaining races this season.", "sql": "SELECT round, race_name, country, race_start_utc FROM f1.main.current_schedule WHERE race_date >= current_date ORDER BY round"}]
rows.vgi.title: F1 Season Calendar

rows: CREATE TABLE current_schedule(season INTEGER, round INTEGER, race_name VARCHAR, circuit_id VARCHAR, circuit_name VARCHAR, locality VARCHAR, country VARCHAR, race_date DATE, race_start_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, first_practice_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, second_practice_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, third_practice_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, sprint_qualifying_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, sprint_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, qualifying_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, is_sprint_weekend BOOLEAN, wikipedia_url VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(round));
Current-season constructors' championship standings, one row per team

rows.vgi.doc_llm: The current season's constructors' (teams') championship, one row per constructor. Use constructor_standings() for another season or a specific round.
rows.vgi.doc_md: The current constructors' championship as an ordinary read-only table.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Current constructors' table.", "sql": "SELECT position, constructor_name, points, wins FROM f1.main.current_constructor_standings ORDER BY position"}]
rows.vgi.title: F1 Constructors' Standings

rows: CREATE TABLE current_constructor_standings(season INTEGER, round INTEGER, "position" INTEGER, position_text VARCHAR, points DECIMAL(7,2), wins INTEGER, constructor_id VARCHAR, constructor_name VARCHAR, constructor_nationality VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(constructor_id));
Current-season drivers' championship standings, one row per driver

rows.vgi.doc_llm: The current season's drivers' championship after the latest round, one row per driver. Start here for who leads the title race, points gaps, and wins this season. For another season or the table after a specific round, call driver_standings().
rows.vgi.doc_md: The current Formula 1 drivers' championship as an ordinary read-only table, refreshed from Jolpica-F1 at most every ten minutes. Points are exact decimals.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "The current championship top ten.", "sql": "SELECT position, driver_name, constructor_name, points, wins FROM f1.main.current_driver_standings ORDER BY position LIMIT 10"}, {"description": "Points gap from each driver to the leader.", "sql": "SELECT driver_name, points, max(points) OVER () - points AS gap_to_leader FROM f1.main.current_driver_standings ORDER BY position"}]
rows.vgi.title: F1 Drivers' Standings

rows: CREATE TABLE current_driver_standings(season INTEGER, round INTEGER, "position" INTEGER, position_text VARCHAR, points DECIMAL(7,2), wins INTEGER, driver_id VARCHAR, driver_code VARCHAR, permanent_number INTEGER, driver_name VARCHAR, driver_nationality VARCHAR, constructor_id VARCHAR, constructor_name VARCHAR, constructor_ids VARCHAR, constructor_names VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(driver_id));
